name: Guardians of Ancora
shortDescription: A free Scripture Union England and Wales Bible-story game for children aged about eight to eleven. It has English and Welsh play, Bible quests, videos, quizzes and club resources.
suitableContexts: Children's ministry for roughly ages eight to eleven
Church or school clubs using a shared tablet or projected game activity
English- or Welsh-language Bible-story engagement outside core church records

pricing.summary: The supplier describes Guardians of Ancora as free, with no advertising or in-app purchases. The public site does not state a paid church plan, implementation service or support agreement; obtain current platform availability and any group-use conditions before building it into a programme.

gdprInformation: Guardians of Ancora is intended for children, so churches should use it only with appropriate adult supervision and their own safeguarding processes. The reviewed public product material does not establish the current privacy, player-profile, device-data or third-party-processing position; obtain this directly before use. Do not enter child safeguarding, attendance or pastoral data into the app.
coreFeatures: Up to three player profiles on one device
integrations: Designed for tablet and smartphone use
Supplier club guidance describes projecting the game on a large screen
No church-management, check-in, safeguarding or donation integration is established
importExport: No church-data import or export workflow identified
Do not treat local player profiles as ministry records
support: Supplier provides a contact route and frequently asked questions
Scripture Union publishes club resources for group use
Confirm current device compatibility and support before deployment

uk-operator.value: The product site identifies Guardians of Ancora as a project by Scripture Union England & Wales Ltd.

product-scope.value: Supplier describes a free Bible-story game for eight- to eleven-year-olds with no adverts or in-app purchases, while Scripture Union publishes club guidance for using it with children.

mobile-availability.value: The product site describes Guardians of Ancora as a free game for mobile devices with English and Welsh gameplay.

editorial.assessment: Guardians of Ancora is a free UK children’s Bible-engagement game, not a children’s check-in, safeguarding, curriculum-planning or church-management system. It is most plausible as an optional supervised activity for ages around eight to eleven, especially where a church can use the supplier's club guidance. Its age group, shared-device profiles and app-data declaration make adult supervision, current device testing and clear separation from church child records essential.
bestFor: Churches seeking a free, game-based Bible-story activity for junior-aged children
Supervised clubs that can use a shared device or projected activity
English- and Welsh-language children’s Bible engagement
strengths: Free with no adverts or in-app purchases stated
Specific junior-age focus and group-use resources
limitations: Not a child check-in, safeguarding, attendance or family-communication system
Current device compatibility needs testing before group use
Current privacy information and any player-account or profile behaviour require review
Designed for a narrow age band rather than a full children’s curriculum

procurementVerdict.problem: Offering a supervised, age-appropriate Bible-story activity without buying a full children’s ministry platform
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A free UK Scripture Union game with Bible quests and supporting club-use material
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Install and test the current app on the church's intended device, review its privacy policy and profile controls, involve the safeguarding lead in the supervised-use plan, and keep all child attendance or pastoral data in the church's approved system.
